issues.issue: Whether new police reports should be admitted and whether an oral hearing is needed
issues.applicant_position: Three new police reports should be admitted and show he was targeted; oral hearing requested.
issues.result_text: Police reports admitted as new evidence, but they do not require a hearing or reverse the decision; hearing denied.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD properly weighed Exhibit P-3 and the request-for-guarantees document
issues.applicant_position: RPD gave no serious reasons for discounting Exhibit P-3 and the request for guarantees.
issues.result_text: RPD had the advantage of questioning him and did not err in finding P-3 not probative.

issues.issue: Whether the appellant's credibility on the extortion timeline and omissions is adversely affected
issues.applicant_position: Narrative was out of order, not inconsistent; the core targeting account is genuine.
issues.result_text: Inconsistencies and omissions on targeting by Mr. XXXX are unexplained; burden not met on balance of probabilities.

issues.issue: Whether the appellant was targeted by Mr. XXXX and the Puerto Nuevo gang
issues.applicant_position: New exhibits show he was targeted by a very dangerous man.
issues.result_text: Targeting not established; the news and police evidence contradict the claim of impunity.
